correctness.rationale: Exact nine-dimensional invariant decomposition is verified symbolically from the specified Lindblad generator. Discriminant -4(2q^4-61q^2+512)<0 for q>0 proves one real cubic root and a conjugate pair; shifted cubic Routh-Hurwitz coefficients are positive and AB>C on both sides of q=2sqrt2. This proves the even spectral abscissa strictly less than the odd for every q>0. Cyclicity of the initial deviations P and U excludes cancellation of leading modes, including the odd Jordan point. The local entropy expansion (3/2)Tr(X^2)+O(||X||^3) proves the two exact log-rate limits and eventual reversal of initial entropy ordering. Directly assembled independent 9x9 numerical spectra and 387 symbolic, spectral, positivity and symmetry checks passed in check.py, but finite sampling is not the proof. Boundary gamma=0 is excluded.

originality.rationale: The 2024 source gives the identical generator, entropy criterion, numerical Mpemba examples and a strong-dephasing classical odd-chain mode argument. The exact three-site parity characteristic polynomial and strict even/odd root-real-part inequality for every positive dephasing ratio, including explicit mixed-state pairs and weak/strong rate-ratio limits, are not statements found in the examined primary works. General symmetry filtering is known, and publication priority is qualified by missing supplemental full text and incomplete global literature coverage.
residual_risks: The separately cited supplemental document to Longhi (2024) was not available for full-text inspection. The accessible main article describes supplemental eigenmode analysis as confined to the strong-dephasing classical limit.
The 2026 many-body symmetry-protection preprint was assessed from its abstract only; no claim about its full text is made.
Broad Liouvillian symmetry methods are existing theory; novelty is model-specific all-rate quantitative classification, not the qualitative Mpemba mechanism.
Search-based absence cannot establish exhaustive publication priority; an unindexed spectral classification could cover the result.

value.rationale: The three-site path is the smallest spatially symmetric single-particle chain with a nontrivial center-localized state and odd mode. A physical, all-positive-dephasing guarantee of stronger entropy relaxation, including exact gaps and asymptotic speed ratios, closes the main source’s strong-dephasing-vs-coherent regime gap. The distinction between parity-based mode exclusion and an actually strictly slower odd mode is substantive, and the cubic Hurwitz proof resolves it globally. The theorem gives a complete natural finite-dimensional classification without claiming a many-body theorem, rate-independent time to crossover, or generic universality.
